objective: Create and seal a fresh fixed-pool qualification cohort for an Evidence Bundler obligation selector using only composition identity, claim-native subject identity, and mechanically derived expected evidence forms. Do not expose selector implementation, development results, arm ordering, or expected winner before prereveal freeze.

isolation_surface.provider: GitHub Copilot CLI via GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN
isolation_surface.tool_policy: deny shell, write, url, and memory; disable builtin MCP; invoke from fresh trusted empty directory with a fresh COPILOT_HOME per call
isolation_surface.rule: Each invocation receives only one fully rendered prompt containing explicitly allowlisted prereveal content. It starts a fresh Copilot session and cannot access the repository checkout through its working-directory path permissions.

claim_profile_authority.purpose: derive expected_evidence_forms mechanically after claims freeze and before corpus authoring

prereveal_allowed_files: authoring prompt files and target-agnostic apparatus committed on this bootstrap branch
proposition-authoring exact claim-profile authority named above
prereveal_denylist: PRs #109 through #116 bodies, comments, diffs, checks, artifacts, result branches, or source not explicitly allowlisted
Gate-specialty development/result branches and PRs #95 through #108
normal CAL Pipeline conversation history, saved summaries, project memory, or other answer-bearing development summaries
post-reveal arm mapping, selector stage order, semantic-loss cap, or expected winner
prereveal_allowed_knowledge: The scientific factors under study are parent/child composition, exact claim-native subject identity, and expected evidence form.
Subject values must be exact substrings of the frozen parent or child claim and may not come from evidence.
Expected evidence forms are derived mechanically from the exact frozen Claim Profile implementation, not authored from corpus evidence.
The study is a fixed-pool post-retrieval selector qualification and makes no first-stage retrieval claim.
Correct and wrong/mixed controls will be executed after reveal, but the authoring lane does not know the implementation or arm ordering.
required_freeze_order: author 24 fresh parent claims and exactly two meaning-preserving all_of child propositions per parent
freeze claims and claim-native subject bindings
derive and freeze expected_evidence_forms mechanically from exact Claim Profile authority
author fresh 10-candidate pools using frozen claims/descriptors
freeze candidate text and construction metadata
compute and freeze exact semantic scores for both children
adjudicate candidate gold from sanitized claim+candidate inputs without descriptor metadata
return to fresh-input base and commit READY_FOR_REVEAL receipt referencing sealed-gold identities
required_outputs: 24 fresh parents / 48 children balanced across six categories
FRESH-INPUT.json with frozen semantic scores and no gold
contamination_rule: If any denylisted target/development material is supplied to or opened by the isolated authoring/evaluation lane before READY_FOR_REVEAL, terminate as CONTAMINATED_PRE_FREEZE and preserve the run.
nonclaims: This bootstrap does not qualify or promote any selector.
The fresh study qualifies post-retrieval selection only, not first-stage retrieval.
An explicit subject binding used by EB does not itself qualify the upstream subject extractor/producer.
